title: INDIAN BOYS AT SAVOY COLLEGE, 1884-85
text: [Photograph: INDIAN BOYS AT SAVOY COLLEGE, 1884-85. Caption text (rotated, partially legible): Front row — [names illegible]. Back row — [names illegible]. The photograph shows a group of approximately twelve to fourteen young men posed outdoors, believed to be Indian students enrolled at Savoy College during the 1884-85 school year.]
notes: Full-page photograph. Caption is printed sideways along the edge of the page and is largely illegible in this scan. Shows Indian boys enrolled at Savoy College.
